relations.note: Welsh tradition names Modron daughter of Afallach as Owain's mother.
Afallach is Owain's maternal grandfather through Modron.
Later Arthurian genealogies make Morgan Owain's mother instead of Modron.
Morgan's magical ointment, administered by an attendant, cures Yvain's madness.

relations.myth: The ravens retaliate against Arthur's forces
relations.note: Owain commands his supernatural war-birds to attack Arthur's men.

relations.myth: The lion's battle with the serpent
relations.note: Yvain chooses to save the lion from a serpent or dragon.

relations.myth: Adventures of the Knight of the Lion
relations.note: The grateful lion becomes Yvain's voluntary companion and co-combatant.

relations.myth: The lion's battle with the serpent
relations.note: Yvain kills the serpent or dragon while rescuing the lion.

relations.myth: Rescue from Harpin of the Mountain
relations.note: Yvain defeats the giant to rescue captives and aid Gawain's relatives.

relations.other: the two sons of the devil
relations.note: Yvain defeats two demonic opponents guarding an exploitative labor castle.
